item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00240","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C17","C02","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":"C17","confidence":0.72,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C17 plausibly supplied the operative framework for the steel telegram: identify an unresolved labor dispute threatening an essential national interest, create a presidential board to investigate and report within a fixed period, and preserve existing working conditions during a cooling-off interval. The child adapts that concrete machinery from a Railway Labor Act order into a voluntary request to steel management and labor. C02 contains nearly identical machinery but is less temporally proximate; C08 supplies the industry-wide emergency and inquiry-board structure but lacks the comparable status-quo provision.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The basic steel industry occupies a strategic and vital position in the economy of the Nation. A cessation of work and operations in that industry would have grave consequences","parent_excerpt":"this dispute... threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within several States to a degree such as to deprive a large portion of the country of essential transportation service","explanation":"Both establish that the labor dispute threatens a strategically essential industry or service and therefore warrants presidential intervention."},{"child_excerpt":"I am appointing a Board consisting of three public members to investigate and to inquire into the issues in dispute and to report to me thereon within forty-five days","parent_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.","explanation":"Both use a presidential fact-finding board required to report on the dispute within a specified deadline."},{"child_excerpt":"continue work and operations under the terms of the collective bargaining agreements now in effect for a period of sixty days","parent_excerpt":"for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made... in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose","explanation":"Both preserve the status quo for a defined cooling-off period while the board process proceeds."}]}
